name: Wizdier BDIX Repository
description: Free movies, series & anime for CloudStream, built for Bangladesh. Install Wizstream — one extension that gives you BOTH the main Movies/TV catalogue and a dedicated AniList-powered Anime catalogue, backed by six BDIX servers (Circle FTP, Cineplex BD, FTPBD, CTGMovies, FM FTP, Mediaserver) with Cineby/Bingr/Moonflix as web backup. Dead-link pruning, correct multi-season anime episode mapping, AniList/MAL/Kitsu/Simkl tracking, plus optional Wyzie subtitles and MDBList ratings. Seven standalone BDIX extensions also included.
